entries.title: Find jobs faster
entries.description: Choose jobs from recent, newly created, or incomplete lists, or search by job code, product, work title, or customer wherever jobs are selected.

entries.title: Focus the schedule board
entries.description: Filtering now hides bays without matches while keeping each matching bay’s queue visible, making relevant work easier to find.

entries.title: Recognize scheduled work at a glance
entries.description: Job photos, titles, and customers now appear in picker rows and schedule details. Narrow slots preserve more room for job codes, with removal still available from the details card.

entries.title: Start signed-in sessions reliably
entries.description: The app now waits for account details to finish loading before routing or retrieving user data, preventing incorrect sign-in redirects and stale cached content during startup.
